$comment: Source configuration for each general election. To add an election: put its files in data/<year>/ and add an entry here (or rely on auto-detection, which recognises the file layouts below).
format: e9 = 2008-2014 'e9_part8_party_N.csv' files; votingplace = 2017+ 'party-votes-by-voting-place-N.csv'; xlsx = per-electorate workbooks with a 'Party' sheet.
coordinates.kind: csv (Electoral Commission voting-place coordinate CSV) | places-json (vote.nz style places.json).
coordinates.fallback: other years' coordinate files used ONLY to infer locations by exact/near-exact address match, when an election's own coordinate file is missing or wrong.
status: 'final' (official results) or 'preliminary'. Preliminary results exclude special votes and may change.

elections.coordinates_fallback_note: NZMG does not cover the Chatham Islands, so the 2008 Chatham coordinate is invalid; venues without a valid 2008 coordinate fall back to the 2014 file (same-electorate, near-exact address match only).

coordinates.note: data/2011/2014_Voting_Place_Co-ordinates.csv is byte-identical to the 2014 coordinate file, so it is NOT treated as a 2011 source. 2011 venues are located by address match against the 2014 and 2008 coordinate files.

elections.coordinates_fallback_note: 2014 is preferred over 2008 when an address appears in both; later years are then tried with exact address matches only.
